description: The two synthetic .epru SYMBOL library streams the differential case book publishes as symbol-library-sample inputs. Each entry is one record stream plus the pinKey its pins are addressed by: the V3 .epro2 case keys a PIN row by the synthesised e<zIndex> while its envelope id is something else, and the V4 case keys it by the row's own id. The text below is the whole input: no editor session, container or fixture is read to obtain it, and no line names a real project. The generator writes one symbol-library-sample-v1 document per entry into its run directory and projects it exactly like a producer's output.
